{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Arena''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] arena, that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
The Imperial Arena was built during the reign of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and was still in use during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
